Dear reviewers, we are pleased to inform you that we have successfully completed Milestone 2: "The First Generation is Incubated" ahead of schedule. All 9 outputs proposed for this milestone have been fully accomplished, as detailed below.
Due to the early completion of this milestone, we are submitting our PoA earlier than anticipated. We kindly request your assistance in completing the Proof of Achievement (PoA) process as soon as possible. Our goal is to enable our team to receive funding by the second Monday of September. Securing funding at this time is crucial for us to maintain our project's momentum. We appreciate your understanding of our situation and your continued support.
Please, we kindly request your prompt review and approval of our Proof of Achievement. From the date of submission, we will be checking this PoA module every 8-hours, starting at Friday August 30th at 8PM East Time. In the event of any refusal or concerns, before that actions we urge you to initiate a discussion with us through the chat feature of the Milestones Module.
The technical partners providing expertise and support for the DAO Incubation Program, first and second generation, are Clarity Protocol Team and Summon Platform Team.
The following incubated organizations were represented in the program's first generation: The Chilean Network of Woman and Dissident Musicians (TRAMUS), Proyecto ARDE, Cooperativa La Fuga (LA FUGA) and METRO 21. It is important to note that only one representative from the directory board of METRO21 (Alonso) participated in the program. He attended the classes jointly with LA FUGA. Therefore, his participation is documented in the recordings of each class alongside LA FUGA.
Shared Evidence Folder and Reports for Attendance and Feedback

Dear Reviewers, we hope this report finds you well.
We are pleased to inform you that we have successfully completed Milestone 3: "The Second Generation is Incubated" and are on the verge of finalizing Milestone 4 (Final).
All outputs for Milestone 3 have been fully accomplished, as detailed below, and Final Milestone is nearing completion. To expedite our project close-out and ensure timely funding, we kindly request your review and approval of this Milestone 3 Proof of Achievement report. A swift approval for Milestone 3 and 4 will ensure our funding is included in the January primary distribution.
We understand that we are submitting both reports before the 20th, and we are committed to ensuring all documentation and evidence are correctly timestamped and submitted within the required deadlines.
We will be checking this PoA module every 8 hours, starting from today (13th December), to promptly address any questions or concerns you may have.
In the event of any concerns and potential refusals, please we urge you to initiate a discussion with us through the chat feature of the Milestones Module. This 8-hours checks will allow us to respond promptly.

The technical partners providing expertise and support for the DAO Incubation Program, first and second generation, are Clarity Protocol Team and Summon Platform Team.
The following incubated organizations were represented in the program's second generation:
IME Chile (Union of Chilean Electronic Music Workers), Cooperativa RONDA, Cooperativa MUJER LATINA, and 437 Club.
It's important to highlight the unique participation structures within this cohort. While some individuals attended classes jointly with other organizations, each organization received dedicated training and support tailored to their specific needs and goals.
